detail.longDescription:
Tired of “Storage almost full”? Clean Manager helps you reclaim space safely without the fluff. Scan your device, review what’s taking up room, and clean with confidence. 

WHAT YOU CAN DO 
• Delete duplicate and similar photos & videos 
• Clear old screenshots and blurred shots 
• Find and remove large files by size 
• Compress photos and videos to save space 
• Review before you delete, stay in control 
• Optional widgets to monitor storage & battery 

HOW IT WORKS 
1) Smart Scan groups clutter (duplicates, screenshots, large files) so you can act fast. 
2) Preview items side-by-side to keep only the best. 
3) Use built-in compression to shrink media while keeping quality. 

WHY CLEAN MANAGER 
• Fast, focused, privacy-minded design 
• Clear explanations before any change 
• From the makers of popular utility apps used by millions 

Tips: Clean Manager focuses on the biggest wins, duplicates, screenshots, large files, and safe compression—for real, lasting space savings. With Clean Manager, your private photos and videos are safe and protected.

Purchases & Subscriptions: This app offers in-app purchases and auto-renewable subscriptions through the App Store / Google Play. Payment is charged to your account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your account settings.
